Map data coordinates into a panel's canvas npc coordinates

Source: R/canvas.R
seq_to_canvas.Rd

Maps genomic x and data y values into one panel of a track, the same way the built-in elements do: x through the panel's x plot range and y through its y plot range (falling back to the scale limits), into the panel's inner rectangle. Use it in prep() of custom elements and links, including links that place values on another track via layout_all_tracks[[track_id]].

Usage

seq_to_canvas(x, y, panel, apply_transform = TRUE, clamp = TRUE)

Arguments

x

Numeric vector of genomic (or x-axis) positions.

y

Numeric vector of y values in the track's axis units.

panel

One panel-metadata list, e.g. layout_track[[w]] in an element's prep() or layout_all_tracks[[track_id]][[w]] in a link's.

apply_transform

Logical. Apply the panel's y_transform (set by transformed scales such as seq_scale_count()) to y first. Use FALSE for values that were already transformed by resolve().

clamp

Logical. Clamp the result to the panel's inner rectangle.

Value

A list with numeric vectors x and y in canvas npc units. NA inputs stay NA.

Examples

panel <- list(xscale = c(0, 100), yscale = c(0, 1),
              inner = list(x0 = 0.1, x1 = 0.9, y0 = 0.2, y1 = 0.8))
seq_to_canvas(c(25, 50), c(0, 0.5), panel)
#> $x
#> [1] 0.3 0.5
#> 
#> $y
#> [1] 0.2 0.5
#>
